title: Elijah and the Ravens
summary: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read 1 Kings 17:1-16 and look for how this passage teaches: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.

tell_it: God cared for Elijah during a drought. Ravens brought food, and later God provided through a widow's jar and jug.
understand_it: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: Elijah and the Ravens reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Provision matters.
age_8_11_explanation: Elijah and the Ravens shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.
teen_explanation: Elijah and the Ravens gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when provision is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What birds brought food to Elijah?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: Ravens. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember 1 Kings 17:6 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in Elijah and the Ravens?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Provision Path
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God can provide in surprising ways when His servants depend on Him.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from Elijah and the Ravens. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
